== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タルズ</span>. Three asterisks precede the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">武器が命中した他のキャラクターと同じ位置カードにいれば、その代わりに没収してよい。命中を受けたキャラクターは元にもどされる。「夜間状態」にあるタルズは、戦闘力に＋2</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">マフタックは、帝国が隷属化した星系の内、アルゾックIII出身のタルズ人男性である。二対の目の内小さな方は優れた暗視能力を持つ。マフタックはカーベの友人で保護者。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Talz]].

'''Lore''' — Muftak is a male Talz from Alzoc III, one of the systems the Empire enslaved. The smaller of his two pairs of eyes has excellent night vision. Muftak is Kabe's friend and protector.

'''Game text''' — If at the same location card as another character hit by a weapon, you may forfeit in that character's place. The hit character is restored. A Talz under “nighttime conditions” is power +2.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Three asterisks. Japanese specifies the smaller pair of eyes for night vision. Game text uses 位置カード, 没収, 「夜間状態」, and タルズは rather than “any Talz”. The last sentence has no period.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-talz.gif|Original English face]], [[Talz]].</ref>
